newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: EU, Asia finalise ASEM investment promotion plan.
newsitem.headline: EU, Asia finalise ASEM investment promotion plan.

text.p: Representatives of ASEM, the main European Union-Asia discussion forum, have finalised a plan to boost two-way investment flowing between the regions, the Luxembourg EU presidency said in a statement on Tuesday.

The ASEM Investment Promotion Action Plan (IPAP) was concluded during a meeting in Luxembourg between representatives of the 10 Asian countries, 15 EU members and the European Commission that together make up the ASEM partners.
"The ASEM partners believe the IPAP is the first of many tangible initiatives arising from the strengthening process of dialogue and co-operation between Asia and Europe," the statement said.

It said that to prepare the plan, which involved 12 months of consultations, extensive interviews had been carried out with Asian and European businesses on their investment activities and the challenges they faced doing business overseas.
One part of the plan focuses on investment promotion, including exchanging information via the Internet, and intensifying business-to-business exchange programmes.

A second part aims to foster the investment environment by improving policy and regulatory frameworks in areas of common interest and of relevance to business. This would create high-level dialogue on key investment issues, the statement said.
The plan will be submitted to an ASEM Economic Ministers meeting in Japan in September for endorsement, and then be passed onto the second ASEM Leaders Meeting due to be held in London next April.
